sourceAnchors.message: Ensure that resources like this ExecutorService object are closed after use
sourceAnchors.reason: This exact executor is owned before try and every exit reaches finally shutdownNow plus bounded awaitTermination10s, with nontermination an explicit failing assertion. ExecutorService.close would be unbounded; no resource owner is ignored or returned.

sourceAnchors.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
sourceAnchors.reason: This exact pool/submit/shutdown/await site belongs only to a whole JUnit data-codec test, not a managed J2EE/webapp component. It owns8workers, joinsall64futures5s andfinallyshutdownNow/await10assert; no business async or authority callback.

sourceAnchors.reason: This exact test finally enforces the independently required worker termination postcondition. Its InterruptedException or AssertionError must fail the Test and cannot return PASS; it neither returns nor normalizes the original failure. Not a production business finally policy exception.
